title: Account Executive - EMEA Specialist
description: Who we are Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale. Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term. About the role: Samsara is seeking a high-impact, strategic seller to lead the go-to-market execution for our newest frontiers in Connected Equipment. As an Enterprise Specialist (Overlay), you will partner with our Account Executives (AEs) to build deep partnerships with our largest, most complex accounts. You aren't just selling a tool; you are pioneering GTM, ensuring our customers realize continuous value from new products as a part of the overall platform. This specialist reports into the VP of Sales, EMEA and will be aligned by segment and product. AEs on the team are charged with accelerating the growth of one or more new product(s) and will be incentivized on quarterly product sales targets mapped to mainline sellers in the segment. Product Specialist sellers drive growth through strategic, high-value deal executing and enabling the segment overall to be successful. This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the United Kingdom. You should apply if: You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact – helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely. You have an innate curiosity about how businesses work: One day you're meeting with a VP of Operations in waste management; the next, you're diving into the logistics of a global food distributor. You seek to understand the "unit of value" for every customer. You build genuine, high-stakes relationships: Our customers operate in "boots-on-the-ground" industries. They value earned trust and partners who understand their operational realities. You want to be with the best: Samsara's high-performance culture means you'll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before. You are a team Player: In an overlay role, your success is tied to the success of the broader account team. You lead through influence, not just authority. In this role, you will: Architect deals that align Samsara's new products value with customer use cases to provide maximum value and return on investment Co-generate new product pipeline with ADRs/AEs across high propensity to buy accounts Drive strategy and pilot/trial success Provide commercial insights and pricing benchmarks often for unique set of competitors in the market Partner with GTM and Product to feed back insights and help shape roadmap Build frameworks, assets and insights that scale across the sales org Travel 20%+ to meet customers where they physically operate and to advance solutions and deals Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices Minimum requirements for the role: 5+ years in complex, full-cycle Enterprise sales. Proven Track Record: Consistent quota over-achievement in complex accounts with £500k+/€500k+ ARR transactions. Deal Complexity: Demonstrated success navigating 6- and 7-figure deals involving multiple stakeholders (Legal, Procurement, InfoSec, and C-Suite). Entrepreneurial Agility: Experience selling new products where the playbook is still being written. An ideal candidate also has: Experience working in a specialist/overlay co-selling with a mainline AE team. Second language experience in French or German at business-level proficiency. Total Rewards At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time. Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here. Flexible Working At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable. Belonging at Samsara At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact. Accommodations Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process. Our Commitment to Authenticity We use Tofu , a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara's Candidate Privacy Notice for more information. Fraudulent Employment Offers Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. title: Senior Consultant (Commerce)
description: <div class="content-intro"><h4><strong>Who We Are</strong></h4> <p>WPP Enterprise Solutions designs, builds, and operates the growth systems that competitive businesses rely on. WPP Enterprise Solutions works alongside best-in-class partners including Adobe, AWS, Braze, Google, Microsoft, Salesforce, and Shopify, as well as innovators in AI, to deliver growth solutions tailored to the needs of our clients’ businesses. VML, part of WPP, supports WPP Enterprise Solutions by helping brands activate transformation through creativity and experience.</p></div><h3>Senior Consultant with experience in Commerce ecosystems and technologies wanted to join our Business Services team </h3> <h3>The opportunity:</h3> <p>How consumers discover, evaluate and buy products is changing faster than most organisations can respond. AI-powered search, agentic commerce, generative product discovery and the collapse of the traditional funnel are reshaping commercial models across every sector. Most enterprise clients know something has shifted, few have a clear plan for what to do about it.</p> <p>WPP Enterprise Solutions is building a commerce consulting practice to help clients navigate these shifts. We work with some of the world's most recognised brands, translating complex commercial challenges into actionable strategies, transformation roadmaps and delivery programmes. What makes this role different from a boutique or a SaaS provider is what sits around you: your consulting recommendations connect directly to creative, content, CX and commerce execution teams who bring them to life. Strategy doesn't end at a slide deck here.</p> <p>We're looking for a Senior Consultant who can own projects and client relationships. Someone who takes an ambiguous brief, structures it independently, drives the strategic direction and ensures the quality of everything the team delivers. You'll lead client conversations, design and facilitate workshops, and be the person mid-to-senior client stakeholders trust to connect diagnostic findings to commercial action. You'll also play a key role in growing the practice, spotting extension opportunities within accounts, contributing to pitches and coaching more junior members of the team.</p> <ul> <li><strong>Perm </strong></li> <li><strong>London/Hybrid </strong></li> <li><strong>Travel to client site where required</strong></li> </ul> <h3>What you’ll be doing:</h3> <p><em><strong>Project Leadership & Delivery</strong></em></p> <ul> <li>Own medium-scale projects end-to-end: scope, quality, delivery timeline, and client relationship. Accountable for the strategic direction and the standard of output.</li> <li>Lead the development of strategic recommendations across commerce transformation, AI discoverability (GEO/AEO), agentic commerce readiness, content strategy and channel optimisation - shaping the narrative, not just building the analysis.</li> <li>Take ambiguous or loosely defined briefs and structure them into clear project plans with defined deliverables, milestones and resource requirements.</li> <li>Build and codify delivery methodologies into repeatable, scalable frameworks the wider team can execute against.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Client Leadership:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Design and lead workshops, stakeholder interviews and co-creation sessions. You will be comfortable going off-script when the conversation requires it and steering senior client stakeholders toward actionable outcomes.</li> <li>Serve as a trusted advisor to mid-to-senior client contacts. You are the person they call when they need the thinking sharpened or the direction challenged.<br>Anticipate and respond to client questions in a compelling and informed way. Own the client relationship day-to-day, identifying when senior escalation or support is needed.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Business Development:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Identify growth opportunities within existing accounts - spot the extension, the adjacent brief, the unasked question and work with senior leadership to convert them.</li> <li>Contribute meaningfully to proposals and pitch responses: shaping the strategic approach, writing key sections, and presenting to prospective clients where appropriate.</li> <li>Build client relationships that generate repeat work - not just deliver well, but leave clients wanting more.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Team & Practice Building:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Coach and develop Consultants on the team: Setting the quality bar on projects, giving direct feedback, and creating opportunities for junior team members to stretch.</li> <li>This role may line-manage 1–2 team members, depending on team structure.</li> <li>Drive practice IP development: reusable frameworks, case studies, proposition collateral and points of view that strengthen our market position and make selling easier.</li> <li>Work across WPP's integrated network: connecting upstream consulting recommendations to downstream execution in content, CX and commerce.</li> </ul> <h3>What we want from you:</h3> <ul> <li>Extensive professional experience, with a strong track record in consulting, strategy or senior commercial/digital roles (ideally blending both)</li> <li>Deep understanding of how commerce ecosystems work: You've either run a commerce operation (brand-side) or advised on one (agency/consulting-side). You understand how trading, content, category management, channel strategy and technology intersect in practice.</li> <li>Working knowledge of AI discoverability: GEO, AEO, LLM-influenced discovery, AI assistants and conversational commerce. You can advise a Head of Digital or VP of eCommerce on what this shift means for their business and back it up with a credible action plan.</li> <li>Proven ability to lead projects independently - you've managed scope, quality and client expectations without someone looking over your shoulder.</li> <li>Strong strategic and analytical thinking: you can take a diagnostic output or a data-heavy assessment and turn it into a clear, commercially prioritised set of recommendations with a compelling narrative.</li> <li>Excellent communication and executive presence - you're comfortable leading a room, running a workshop, and navigating a difficult client conversation with credibility.</li> <li>Experience building methodology or practice IP: You've created frameworks, playbooks or delivery approaches that others have adopted and scaled.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Ideally you will have:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Brand-side experience in eCommerce, digital marketing or commercial leadership - you've lived the reality of managing a P&L, running a digital operation, or leading a commerce team. management or enablement experience: you've helped organisations adopt new operating models, not just designed them.</li> <li>Line management or mentoring experience.</li> </ul> <p><strong>If you know title: Senior Account Manager, MyTutor
description: <p>Ready to make a real difference in education? Join MyTutor, the UK's leading online one-to-one tutoring platform and part of the IXL Learning family. We're on a mission to improve education for everyone, and we're looking for an enthusiastic Senior Account Manager to help us achieve it.</p> <p>In this role you will be developing and managing relationships with school administrators across the UK to ensure customer satisfaction throughout the customer life-cycle. You will handle Tutoring renewals, expansions, customer retention and engagement activities in assigned territory. You will collaborate and work closely with your field sales counterparts to develop and execute towards strategic goals.   </p> <p>To be successful in this role, you must be proactive, well organized and extremely personable, ensuring strategic communication touchpoints for multiple accounts. title: Data Scientist - Partner Flow Team
description: Data Scientist - Partner Flow - UK Hybrid in London, United Kingdom We're looking for a Data Scientist to join the Partner Flow team. You'll use experiments and causal inference to shape how iwoca grows through its partners – the fintechs and platforms that offer iwoca lending inside their own products. The company Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don't wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that's as flexible and responsive as they are. That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed. We've already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive. The team Partner Flow owns the journey for small businesses that come to iwoca through a partner platform, from how they discover iwoca’s business finance to any repeat lending. The aim is to reach each business at the right time, make it easy to apply and get funded, and match them with the offer that suits them and works best for iwoca over time. The team works on three parts of that journey: The application. Making it smooth and collecting the data a credit decision needs. Routing. Working out which applications get an automatic decision and which need input from a credit analyst. Offer terms. Testing amount, duration, and interest rate, working closely with Credit Risk Modelling, who build the credit models. The team is small and cross-functional – data science, engineering, design, and product – and works across the full application stack, from the APIs partners integrate with to the experience customers see when they apply. The role As the Data Scientist in Partner Flow, you'll run the analysis behind the team's product decisions. Most of it is experiment design and causal inference, with some model building and funnel analysis. You'll own each project from the start. You'll work out what the business needs, reason from first principles, weigh the trade-offs, and shape the project with product, commercial, and strategy colleagues before deciding how it gets done. The team's analytical approach is still young, so you'll help set its methods. Around 10% of your time is for research and learning – finding better methods for the problems in front of you, or new ways to add value. You'll work with data scientists in iwoca's other customer flow teams, and join the analytics guild – iwoca's data science community – to align on methods and build your expertise. Your results reach the wider business through Learnings – short write-ups of what an experiment found, shared at weekly and fortnightly sessions. Live project examples: Pre-qualification. Measuring how showing customers what they could borrow before they apply affects conversion and Customer Lifetime Value (CLtV), then shaping how the model behind it develops. Credit cards. Working out which customers should see iwoca's recently launched credit card, a Flexi-Loan, or both – and whether the card wins extra customers or takes them from Flexi-Loan. Top-up notifications. Measuring whether letting eligible customers know they can borrow more increases CLtV, using causal inference methods beyond a standard A/B test. Partner funnel. Building a clear view from application to drawdown, finding where customers drop off, and testing fixes where they'll matter most. The requirements Essential: Statistical foundations. You have a background in probability and statistics from a quantitative field – typically a degree or Master's in Statistics, Mathematics, Physics, Engineering, or similar. You reason about uncertainty and calibration as first-order concerns. Causal inference and experimentation. You have designed and analysed experiments where separating signal from noise mattered – A/B tests, quasi-experiments, or lift studies. You know where A/B testing breaks down and what to reach for instead. Commercial experience. You have used data science to shape commercial decisions – in an industry role, a consultancy, or a substantial placement – and worked alongside the people who acted on them. Analytical ownership. You have taken loosely defined problems from start to finish – working out the right question, choosing the approach, and seeing the analysis through to a decision. Iteration. You make the best call the current evidence allows and act on it early. As new data comes in, you update the call and tighten the answer. AI leverage. You've used AI to produce work you couldn't have delivered alone – an analysis pipeline, a prototype, or a tool others use. You judge where it helps, and you check its output before anyone acts on it. Communication. You write and speak clearly, directly, and concisely. You adapt technical detail for non-technical colleagues in commercial and strategy roles. Bonus: Causal inference beyond A/B testing. You have used synthetic control, interrupted time series, or difference-in-differences in commercial or research work. Bayesian methods. You have used hierarchical models, MCMC, or Bayesian updating in real work. Funnel and marketplace experience. You have analysed conversion funnels or marketplaces where products compete for customers' attention. Market curiosity. You've explored how the partner lending market works – what makes a partner choose iwoca over a competitor, and what makes a customer convert. Coding. You can write code for analysis. The team works in Python. The salary We expect to pay from £70,000 to £100,000 for this role. But, we’re open-minded, so definitely include your salary goals with your application. We routinely benchmark salaries against market rates, and run quarterly performance and salary reviews. The culture At iwoca, the best idea wins. We model our culture on independent thinking, challenging untested logic, and evidence-based decisions. We prioritise learning and growth, and give people the autonomy to develop in the direction that makes them most effective. We're a tech company and believe in the power of AI to help us work faster and better. We provide the infrastructure where every iwocan always has access to the best models and where those models have access to all of our data. We will help our people to learn how to use and grow with the new tools available to them. The offices We put a lot of effort into making iwoca a great place to work: Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin, and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks. Events and community-led groups, including running groups, padel, and monthly ping-pong and pool competitions. The benefits Flexible working hours. Medical insurance from Vitality, including discounted gym membership. A private GP service (separate from Vitality) for you, your partner, and your dependents. 25 days’ holiday per year, an extra day off for your birthday, the option to buy or sell an additional five days of annual leave, and unlimited unpaid leave. A one-month, fully paid sabbatical after four years. Instant access to external counselling and therapy sessions for team members that need emotional or mental health support. 3% Pension contributions on total earnings. An employee equity incentive scheme. Generous parental leave and a nursery tax benefit scheme to help you save money. Electric car scheme and cycle to work scheme. Two company retreats a year: we’ve been to France, Italy, Spain, and further afield. And to make sure we all keep learning, we offer: A learning and development budget for everyone. Company-wide talks with internal and external speakers. Access to learning platforms like Treehouse. title: Manager, Process Architect
description: Company Description We’re Checkout.com . You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day. We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers. Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale. If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact. With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started. Checkout.com is looking for a strategic, resourceful, and highly-driven Process Architecture Manager to lead the charge on operational excellence within our Finance function. You will not only design processes, which is a key part of this role, but also help define the framework for how we scale FinOps globally. You will act as a partner to Finance leadership, identifying macro-level inefficiencies and driving a culture of continuous improvement. How you’ll make an impact Partner with senior Finance leaders (AP, Treasury, Tax, Accounting) to identify critical operational bottlenecks and prioritize initiatives that deliver the highest ROI. Establish standards, methodologies, and toolkits (e.g., BPMN standards, documentation templates) to ensure consistency and quality across all process improvement projects. Own the end-to-end architecture of complex, cross-functional workflows, ensuring our financial operations scale seamlessly. Define and oversee the reporting of key operational KPIs; identify systemic performance gaps and hold the business accountable for agreed-upon improvements. Lead the change management aspect of process re-engineering, ensuring that new workflows are adopted smoothly by global teams. What we’re looking for 5+ years of experience in Process Excellence, Business Transformation, or Operations, with at least 2 years in a management or lead capacity. Strong understanding of core Finance cycles (e.g., Procure-to-Pay, Record-to-Report, Order-to-Cash) and the control environments required in a regulated fintech. Expertise in process mapping tools (Visio, Lucidchart, FigJam) and methodologies (Lean Six Sigma Black/Green Belt preferred). Proven ability to look at the "big picture" and design an operating model that supports hyper-growth. A deep understanding of how to use AI and automation tools to streamline process efficiency and quality. Exceptional presentation skills, capable of translating complex data into clear strategic recommendations for executive stakeholders. Experience working in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment where you have successfully built structures from scratch. Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands. title: Machine Learning Researcher
description: <h3>About the Position</h3> <p>Our goals are to give you a real sense of what it's like to work at Jane Street as a Machine Learning Researcher while also providing a truly unparalleled educational experience. You'll work side by side with experienced ML Researchers on projects that we've selected for their combination of novel ML ideas and relevance to real-world systematic trading strategies. You'll learn how we think about markets through challenging classes and activities, and practice using established methods alongside our own unique twists to train practical models.</p> <p>At Jane Street, the lines between research, technology, and trading are intentionally blurry, and you’ll have access to petabytes of data, a computing cluster with hundreds of thousands of cores, and a growing GPU cluster containing tens of thousands of high-end GPUs. Trading poses unusual challenges—large models and nonstationary datasets in a competitive multi-agent environment—that force us to search for novel techniques.</p> <p>You'll spend the bulk of your internship working closely with full-time machine learning researchers on projects drawn from their own work. You might conduct an end-to-end study of an unexplored dataset, try a new modelling paradigm for a thorny problem, or consider blue-sky approaches that we're still trying to figure out. The problems we work on rarely have clean, definitive answers, and they often require insights from colleagues across the firm with different areas of expertise. Depending on the day, you might be diving deep into market data, tuning hyperparameters, debugging training issues, or analysing the predictions your model makes.</p> <p>Note that given the IP-sensitive nature of machine learning research at Jane Street, it is unlikely that any research findings associated with the internship will be suitable for outside academic publication.</p> <h3>About you</h3> <p>If you've never thought about a career in finance, you're in good company. Many of us were in the same position before working here. If you have a curious mind and a passion for solving interesting problems, we have a feeling you'll fit right in. We're more interested in how you think and learn than what you currently know. You should be:</p> <ul> <li>An undergraduate, PhD student, or postdoc with practical experience working on ML problems</li> <li>Interested in applying logical and mathematical thinking to all kinds of problems</li> <li>Curious about the machine learning landscape and excited to apply state-of-the-art techniques drawn from many problem domains</li> <li>Fluent with a versatile set of models and tricks</li> <li>Able to rapidly implement and iterate on your ideas in Python and your favourite ML framework</li> <li>Eager to ask questions, admit mistakes, and learn new things</li> <li>Fluent in English</li> </ul> <p>If you'd like to learn more, you can read about our <a href="https://www.janestreet.com/join-jane-street/ml-research-interviews">interview process</a> and <a href="https://www.janestreet.com/join-jane-street/get-to-know-us/">meet some of the team</a>. Learn more about Jane Street's internship program <a href="https://www.janestreet.com/join-jane-street/internships/">here</a>.</p> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Sales Development Representative - Bilingual (French/English)
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="font-weight: 400;"><strong>About Faire</strong></span></p> <p>Faire is a technology wholesale platform built on the belief that the future is local. Independent retailers around the globe collectively represent a multi-hundred-billion-dollar wholesale market that has historically been fragmented and offline. At Faire, we're using the power of tech, data, and machine learning to connect this thriving community of entrepreneurs across the globe. Picture your favorite boutique in town — we help them discover the best products from around the world to sell in their stores. With the right tools and insights, we believe that we can level the playing field so businesses can grow and local communities can thrive.</p> <p>We’re looking for smart, resourceful and passionate people to join us as we power the shop local movement. If you believe in community, come join ours.</p></div><p><strong>Senior SDR, Enterprise Brand Partnerships<br>Location: </strong>London, UK<strong><br>OTE: </strong>£56,000–£77,000 per year + equity + benefits</p> <p>This role will also be eligible for equity and benefits. Actual base pay will be determined based on permissible factors such as transferable skills, work experience, market demands, and primary work location. The base pay range provided is subject to change and may be modified in the future.</p> <p><strong>About this role</strong></p> <p>Faire’s quality, depth, and breadth of supply is one of our strongest value propositions to retailers, and our Enterprise Brand Partnerships team plays a critical role in bringing strategic, high-value brands onto the platform. As a Senior SDR, you will directly contribute to Faire’s growth by helping scale our enterprise supply strategy and building relationships with brands that will shape the future of our marketplace.We are looking for a strategic and highly motivated sales professional who can independently manage complex outbound prospecting motions, identify high-potential partnership opportunities, and help drive pipeline growth for our Enterprise Account Executive team. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in fast-paced environments, enjoys solving problems creatively, and is excited to contribute beyond their individual pipeline through collaboration, mentorship, and process improvement initiatives.Faire’s goal is to become the default platform for brands to grow their wholesale business and for retailers to discover products for their stores. As we continue to scale, there will be significant opportunities for ownership, impact, and career growth.</p> <p><strong>What you’ll do </strong></p> <ul> <li>Build and execute strategic outbound prospecting motions to engage high-value and enterprise-level brands</li> <li>Prospect, identify, and prioritize brands that are a strong fit for Faire’s retailer ecosystem and long-term marketplace strategy</li> <li>Drive qualified pipeline generation through a mix of cold calls, warm outreach, email campaigns, social selling, and creative prospecting strategies</li> <li>Customize outreach and discovery conversations based on brand pain points, category dynamics, and business goals</li> <li>Partner closely with Enterprise Account Executives to strategically manage territories, prioritize opportunities, and improve conversion outcomes</li> <li>Leverage Salesforce, reporting tools, and sales engagement platforms to track pipeline health, monitor pacing to goals, and optimize outreach strategy</li> <li>Identify workflow inefficiencies, contribute ideas for process improvement, and support broader team initiatives</li> <li>Act as a collaborative partner and trusted resource across the SDR and AE organization by sharing best practices, insights, and learnings</li> <li>Have opportunities to grow into more strategic sales, leadership, enablement, or cross-functional roles within the company</li> </ul> <p><strong>Qualifications</strong></p> <p><strong>Must Haves</strong></p> <ul> <li>A Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional working experience</li> <li>Fluent in French and English</li> <li>Exceptionally strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to confidently lead prospect conversations </li> <li>Strong organization and prioritization skills with the ability to manage a large book of prospective accounts</li> <li>Ability to tailor outreach strategies and messaging based on customer pain points and market context</li> <li>Strong business acumen and curiosity around retail, ecommerce, and marketplace dynamics</li> <li>Experience leveraging data, dashboards, and reporting tools to inform outreach strategy and identify opportunities or gaps</li> <li>Motivated, curious, action-oriented, and proactive in fast-moving environments with evolving priorities</li> <li>Passionate about Faire’s mission and helping entrepreneurs and brands grow their businesses</li> <li>Collaborative mindset with a willingness to contribute to team growth, mentorship, and process improvement</li> </ul> <p><strong>Nice to Haves</strong></p> <ul> <li>1-2 years+ of retail or customer-facing work experience</li> <li>Experience with Salesforce, Salesloft, Looker, or similar sales/reporting platforms</li> <li>Enterprise or strategic account prospecting experience</li> <li>Strong cold calling and objection handling experience</li> <li>Experience working in SaaS, marketplace, ecommerce, or startup environments</li> <li>Retail, merchandising, wholesale, or small business experience</li> <li>Entrepreneurial mindset and desire to help shape a growing sales organization </li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><em><span style="font-weight: 400;"><em data-stringify-type="italic">Hybrid Faire employees currently go into the office 3 days per week on Tuesdays, Thursdays, and a third flex day of their choosing (Monday, Wednesday, or Friday).</em> Additionally, hybrid in-office roles will have the flexibility to work remotely up to 4 weeks per year. Specific Workplace and Information Technology positions may require onsite attendance 5 days per week as will be indicated in the job posting. <br></span></em></p> <p><strong>Why you’ll love working at Faire</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Move fast:</strong> You'll own meaningful problems that serve customers around the globe with the agency to move fast and see your results clearly.</li> <li><strong>Equipped to scale:</strong> We invest in what matters, including the latest enterprise AI tools, to help you work smarter and get more out of every day.</li> <li><strong>Best in class:</strong> Our team is full of sharp, kind, and generous colleagues who care about their craft and about helping you grow in yours.</li> <li><strong>Real rewards.</strong> Competitive pay, equity, and comprehensive benefits designed to support your life inside and outside of work.</li> <li><strong>Belonging:</strong> We're intentional about building an environment where every Faire employee has equal access to opportunities, growth, and success.</li> </ul> <p>Faire was founded in 2017 by a team of early product and engineering leads from Square. We’re backed by some of the top investors in retail and tech including: Y Combinator, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Forerunner Ventures, Khosla Ventures, Sequoia Capital, Founders Fund, and DST Global. To learn more about Faire and our customers, you can read more on our <a href="https://blog.faire.com/">blog</a>.</p> <p></p> <p>Faire provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity or gender expression.</p> <p>Faire is committed to providing access, equal opportunity and reasonable accommodation for individuals with disabilities in employment, its services, programs, and activities. title: Research Data Expert
description:
<p>Hudson River Trading (HRT) is seeking a Research Data Expert to join our Data team. Data is a cornerstone of HRT’s trading strategies, serving as the raw fuel that powers research, automated trading, and risk management.</p> <p>In this role, you will own a specific area of expertise, working on sourcing junior data engineers, platform engineers, and alpha researchers to build and maintain trading strategies. You will also be responsible for providing fully featurized datasets to statistical modeling researchers.</p> <p>HRT does not have information siloes. You will be collaborating directly with our researchers and will be responsible for driving  the business forward through rigorous data analysis and delivery. You will also manage the full end-to-end pipeline from vendor downloads to trading-ready data. As an expert in one area, you will mentor junior data engineers, assisting and validating their work, and will partner with our sourcing team to identify optimal opportunities for data procurement. Furthermore, you will be responsible for ensuring high-quality service by implementing rigorous data checks and alerts.</p> <h2><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Responsibilities</span></h2> <ul> <li>Develop and maintain fully featurized datasets for statistical modeling research</li> <li>Serve as the subject matter expert for a designated data domain</li> <li>Provide technical support and guidance to researchers on vendor data and derived datasets</li> <li>Mentor and direct junior data engineers, including performing code and data output validation</li> <li>Partner with the sourcing team to identify and evaluate new data procurement opportunities</li> <li>Analyze data to identify and improve alpha</li> <li>Manage the full end-to-end data pipeline, from raw vendor ingestion to refined feature sets</li> <li>Provide on-call support for data issues during normal business hours</li> <li>Design and implement automated data quality checks and monitoring alerts</li> </ul> <h2><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Qualifications</span></h2> <ul> <li>Strong programming skills (Python/R preferred) and proficiency in data science methodologies</li> <li>5+ years of professional experience in a specific data domain (e.g., alternative data, fundamentals, security reference, or economic data)</li> <li>Proven track record of building alpha through detailed data analysis</li> <li>Exceptional attention to detail</li> <li>Undergraduate degree in a STEM field</li> </ul> <p>The estimated base salary range for this position is 200,000 to 300,000 USD per year (or local equivalent). The base pay offered may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. This role will also be eligible for discretionary performance-based bonuses and a competitive benefits package.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Culture</strong></p> <p><span data-sheets-value="{"1":2,"2":"Hudson River Trading (HRT) brings a scientific approach to trading financial products. title: Data Scientist Intern - 2027
description:
<p>Hudson River Trading (HRT) is seeking highly motivated full-time students to join our Data Science Summer Internship Program. Data is a cornerstone of HRT’s trading strategies, serving as the raw fuel that powers research, automated trading, and risk management. While Algorithm Developers focus on statistical modeling and Software Engineers focus on the systems that power our trading, HRT Data Scientists focus on extracting useful information from the vast volume of data available in the world. Data Scientists are responsible for normalizing and validating vendor data, extracting features from quantitative and textual data, applying rigorous quality checks, and investigating methodologies for providing the highest quality data for research and trading.</p> <p><strong>What to Expect</strong></p> <ul> <li>A hands-on introduction to data, modeling, and engineering practices in the algorithmic trading industry</li> <li>Independent data investigation projects in Python using open-source libraries such as pandas and polars</li> <li>Opportunities to learn all about HRT's research and trading infrastructure, even in areas you may not be working in directly</li> <li>Technical project work and mentorship, with the opportunity to gain a deeper understanding of global financial markets</li> <li>Plenty of opportunities to connect with fellow interns, participate in team events, and explore the unique culture, food, and experiences that make each HRT office location and cities special</li> </ul> <p><strong>Qualifications</strong></p> <ul> <li>You are a full-time student pursuing a degree in a STEM field — a computer science background is not required</li> <li>Programming experience with Python at the level of “Python for Data Analysis” by Wes McKinney</li> <li>A curiosity for working with data and finding insights </li> <li>Independent data projects, kaggle competitions, and such are a plus</li> <li>Exceptional attention to detail</li> <li>Strong communication skills</li> </ul> <p>We offer a weekly base salary offer in addition to a competitive signing bonus, company-paid housing, meals, and other perks.</p> <p>New York: Weekly base salary of 5,800 USD<br>London: Weekly base salary of 4,350 GBP</p> <p><strong><em>We do not allow multiple applications. Work through how someone discovers a person, decides to follow them, shares an idea or trade, receives a response, and returns. Connect these interactions into an experience users understand without explanation. Make the interaction details work. Shape navigation, information hierarchy, copy, defaults, gestures, and feedback. Specify what happens when a feed is empty, a post fails, content loads slowly, or someone changes their mind. Prototype before committing to a build. Turn ideas into interactive prototypes that communicate the intended behavior. Explore alternatives, test the uncertain parts, and give engineering clear flows, states, and acceptance criteria. Use psychology to improve participation. Understand why people hesitate to post, seek recognition, follow strangers, or respond to others. Translate those motivations into decisions about audience visibility, prompts, reputation, feedback, and the effort required to contribute. Observe users and fix what gets in their way. Run usability sessions, watch people complete tasks, and combine those observations with funnel data. Identify where people misunderstand the product, lose confidence, or abandon an action. Design for first use and repeated use. Make the experience useful before someone has connections. Keep sharing lightweight during an active trading session, with clear control over what becomes public. Test the twentieth interaction as carefully as the first. Connect design decisions to measurable outcomes. For each significant change, define the expected behavior and how to test it. Track task completion, abandonment, first follows, first contributions, responses, and subsequent retention. Work with data science to evaluate experiments and effects on both contributors and their audiences. Take the experience through launch. Choose a focused initial scope, resolve trade-offs with engineering, review the implementation against the intended design, and use post-launch evidence to decide what to improve next. Our focus is on making technology work in the real world and delivering lasting value. </p> <p><strong>THE ROLE</strong> </p> <p>You’ll be part of the Delivery Management Team in Kerv Digital. </p> <p>At Kerv Digital, we help organisations unlock the power of technology to transform how they work, engage customers and drive business value. team</li> <li>ability to work effectively with remote teams in India / UK</li> <li>ability to work flexibly to deliver on-time to tight timescales</li> </ul> <p><strong>What we can do for Flexibility</strong> – A healthy approach for most of our teams seems to be splitting three ways between home, customer sites and the office. </p> <p><strong>Awesome Environment</strong> – all of our The kind of things we do regularly include working with not-for-profits to transform how they leverage technology, working with public bodies to shape digital services and working with top tier private entities to bring genuinely new and meaningful products and services to market. </p> <p><strong>Great Benefits</strong> – all the usual suspects and then some. Our teams in the UK and India thrive in an atmosphere that promotes continuous learning and growth.</p> <p><strong>OUR VALUES</strong> </p> <p>At Kerv, we’re building something special and building it to last. title: Technical Project Manager, Applied AI (Contract)
description: About LILT AI is changing how the world communicates — and LILT is leading that transformation. We're on a mission to make the world's information accessible to everyone , regardless of the language they speak. We use cutting-edge AI, machine translation, and human-in-the-loop expertise to translate content faster, more accurately, and more cost-effectively without compromising on brand, voice, or quality. At LILT, we empower our teammates with leading tools, global collaboration, and growth opportunities to do their best work. Our company virtues— Work together, win together; Find a way or make one; Dance in the customer's shoes; Quicker than they expect; Quality is Job 1 —guide everything we do. We are trusted by Intel Corporation , Canva , the United States Department of Defense , the United States Air Force , ASICS , and hundreds of global Enterprises. Backed by Sequoia, Intel Capital, and Redpoint, we’re building a category-defining company in a $50B+ global translation market being redefined by AI. About the Role We are looking for a Technical Project Manager to join our Applied AI team to lead data programs that help improve automatic speech recognition (ASR) for low-resource and long-tail languages—making speech technology more accurate and accessible for communities underserved by existing AI systems. Four-month fixed-term contract, requiring 4–6 hours per day, with potential for extension. You will own end-to-end program delivery, bringing together multilingual teams, language expertise, and technical capabilities to meet customer goals. This is a high-ownership, outcomes-driven role with accountability for quality, timelines, and budget, and the opportunity to build scalable approaches to complex AI data challenges. This role requires high cross-functional aptitude and a singular focus on getting things done. Successful candidates will be able to demonstrate a history of making significant demands of a business and aligning stakeholders to a project’s success. Key Responsibilities 1. Program and Volume Delivery Delivery planning: Own end-to-end program plans, from pilot and calibration through scaled production and final delivery, aligning scope, staffing, and milestones with customer requirements. Tracking and forecasting: Monitor output against volume and timeline targets, forecast delivery using actual performance, and adjust capacity or workflows to address gaps. Program milestones: Lead readiness reviews, quality checkpoints, and acceptance milestones, coordinating stakeholders and driving timely decisions. Budget and margin: Manage delivery costs against budget and margin targets; proactively flag scope changes, cost pressures, and resource trade-offs. 2. Team Leadership and Capacity Building Build and lead teams: Assemble multilingual delivery teams with the expertise needed for complex AI data programs. Align capacity: Align team capacity and capabilities with program goals. Enable performance: Foster strong performance through clear expectations, training, and feedback. 3. Quality and Data Handling Drive data quality: Ensure AI datasets meet customer standards and support meaningful improvements in model capabilities. Lead continuous improvement: Collaborate with language experts, Quality, and Research to improve data consistency and delivery performance. Uphold responsible data practices: Maintain high standards for privacy, confidentiality, and secure handling of customer data. 4. Reporting and Stakeholder Communication Build customer trust: Serve as a key delivery contact alongside the account team, aligning expectations and maintaining strong customer relationships. Communicate program performance: Translate progress, risks, and trade-offs into clear, actionable updates for customers and internal stakeholders. Drive alignment and decisions: Bring cross-functional teams together to resolve issues, manage changing requirements, and keep programs moving toward shared goals. 5. Tooling and Process Partner with Engineering: Translate program needs into tooling and automation improvements that enable efficient, high-quality AI data delivery. Build for scale: Develop reusable processes and playbooks that capture lessons learned, accelerate future launches, and strengthen delivery across language programs. Qualifications Essential Skills and Experience Experience: 3+ years managing high-volume, deadline-driven service delivery in data annotation, transcription, localization, content operations, BPO or a comparable field. Team leadership: Demonstrated success leading distributed teams to meet demanding delivery and quality goals. Analytical skills: Strong ability to use data, dashboards, and forecasting to guide decisions on delivery, quality, and cost. Quality: Working knowledge of quality assurance for AI training data, including evaluation, sampling, and acceptance criteria. Communication: Excellent written English and the ability to write unambiguous instructions for multilingual contributors. Adaptability: Comfortable bringing structure to ambiguous requirements and leading programs in evolving environments. Availability: Able to commit for the full contract term. Preferred Qualifications Audio data: Experience with speech or audio datasets, ASR training data, or transcription. Global delivery: Experience building or managing multilingual teams across international markets. Data stewardship: Experience delivering programs with privacy, confidentiality, and secure data-handling requirements. Tools: Familiarity with annotation platforms and Jira. Languages: Fluency in an additional language; experience working with low-resource languages is a plus. Our Story Our founders, Spence and John met at Google working on Google Translate. As researchers at Stanford and Berkeley, they both worked on language technology to make information accessible to everyone. While together at Google, they were amazed to learn that Google Translate wasn’t used for enterprise products and services inside the company.The quality just wasn’t there. So they set out to build something better. LILT was born. LILT has been a machine learning company since its founding in 2015. At the time, machine translation didn’t meet the quality standard for enterprise translations, so LILT assembled a cutting-edge research team tasked with closing that gap. While meeting customer demand for translation services, LILT has prioritized investments in Large Language Models, human-in-the-loop systems, and now agentic AI. With AI innovation accelerating and enterprise demand growing, the next phase of LILT’s journey is just beginning. Our Tech What sets our platform apart: Brand-aware AI that learns your voice, tone, and terminology to ensure every translation is accurate and consistent Agentic AI workflows that automate the entire translation process from content ingestion to quality review to publishing 100+ native integrations with systems like Adobe Experience Manager, Webflow, Salesforce, GitHub, and Google Drive to simplify content translation Human-in-the-loop reviews via our global network of professional linguists, for high-impact content that requires expert review LILT in the News Featured in The Software Report’s Top 100 Software Companies! title: Manager, Paid Media
description: About Airwallex Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own. We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific. We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,300 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles to see it in full. About the Role We’re seeking a data-driven and creative Paid Media Manager to plan, execute, and optimize digital campaigns across global paid channels. You’ll own the performance and day-to-day management of paid search, paid social, and display campaigns that drive acquisition, pipeline growth, and ROI. In this role, you’ll blend analytical rigor with hands-on execution — partnering closely with Growth Strategy, Product Marketing, Creative, and Analytics to translate business objectives into efficient, scalable campaigns. You’ll be instrumental in building the frameworks, insights, and best practices that power our global demand generation engine. Key Responsibilities Strategy & Planning Develop and execute multi-channel paid media strategies (SEM, paid social, programmatic/display, YouTube, retargeting) aligned with funnel goals and business priorities. Own budget planning, forecasting, and pacing to meet CAC, ROAS, and pipeline targets. Collaborate with regional and product marketing teams to localize campaigns and ensure relevance across markets. Recommend new growth opportunities, audiences, and channels based on data-driven insights. Execution & Optimization Build and manage paid campaigns end-to-end: keyword/audience selection, ad copy, creative testing, and bid strategy. Continuously optimize for performance , leveraging testing frameworks (A/B, multivariate, holdout experiments) to improve CTR, CVR, and CPL. Monitor and report on campaign performance daily and weekly, identifying trends and actionable insights. Ensure proper tracking and attribution (UTMs, pixels, offline conversions, Salesforce/Marketo sync). Manage and QA all campaign builds following standardized naming conventions and governance frameworks . Cross-Functional Collaboration Partner with Creative and Content to develop ad variations tailored to audience segments and funnel stages. Collaborate with Analytics and RevOps to ensure visibility into lead quality, pipeline contribution, and ROI. Work with Product Marketing to align messaging, audience strategy, and campaign sequencing. Testing & Insights Maintain a structured testing roadmap across channels for creative, audience, and bidding experiments. Surface insights on platform algorithm changes, auction dynamics, and audience performance trends. Share performance learnings across regions to scale best practices globally. Qualifications 5–8 years of experience managing paid media programs in B2B SaaS, fintech, or e-commerce environments. Deep hands-on expertise in the breadth of DemandGen and Acquisition and across ad unit types in Google Ads, LinkedIn Ads, and Meta Ads (other platforms like YouTube, Reddit, Quora, and programmatic are a plus). Experience with marketing automation and CRM systems (Marketo, HubSpot, Salesforce). Exceptional project management and attention to detail — able to run multiple campaigns simultaneously. Excellent communicator who can translate performance data into actionable business insights. description: Applied Intuition, Inc. is powering the future of physical AI. Founded in 2017 and now valued at $15 billion, the Silicon Valley company is creating the digital infrastructure needed to bring intelligence to every moving machine on the planet. Applied Intuition services the automotive, defense, trucking, construction, mining and agriculture industries in three core areas: tools and infrastructure, operating systems, and autonomy. Eighteen of the top 20 global automakers, as well as the United States military and its allies, trust the company’s solutions to deliver physical intelligence. Applied Intuition is headquartered in Sunnyvale, California, with offices in Washington, D.C.; San Diego; Ft. Walton Beach, Florida; Ann Arbor, Michigan; London; Stuttgart; Munich; Stockholm; Bangalore; Seoul; and Tokyo. Learn more at applied.co . We are an in-office company, and our expectation is that full-time employees primarily work from their Applied Intuition office 5 days a week. However, we also recognize the importance of flexibility and trust our employees to manage their schedules responsibly. This may include occasional remote work, starting the day with morning meetings from home before heading to the office, or leaving earlier when needed to accommodate family commitments. This in-office expectation does not apply to contractor positions Senior Robotics Software Engineer About Applied Intuition Defence Applied Intuition UK is a software and infrastructure supplier that accelerates the deployment of next-generation autonomous capabilities to the warfighter across air, land, sea, and space. A subsidiary of Applied Intuition, we deliver dual-use solutions to national security customers that build upon several years of product development and experience from commercial autonomy programs. Based in London, our seasoned defence team hails from Palantir, Anduril, SpaceX, Google, Lockheed Martin, and the UK and US Armed Services. Learn more at appliedintuitiondefense.com . About the role As a Robot Software Engineer, your day-to-day life will vary. Some days you might find yourself out in the field, integrating hardware and software directly onto vehicle platforms and pushing autonomy algorithms through live testing. Other days you'll be back in the office, deep in SIL and HIL environments, working through the complex autonomy and vehicle intelligence systems that span both hardware and software domains. And some days you'll be on-site with a customer, demoing what you built and troubleshooting in real time as they put it to the test. Every day is different, and each one moves the work forward. As a senior member of the team, you'll also help shape how the team tackles these problems, setting technical direction, raising the bar on integration practices, and mentoring engineers as they grow into the role. Along the way, you'll touch whatever it takes to make the platform work, such as mission behaviours development, platform integration, navigation, and everything in between. You'll collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to deliver robust, scalable autonomy solutions for defense customers, drawing on computer networking, code integration, and a genuine passion for robotics. You'll build, test, and deploy your software, and then watch it actually fly. At Applied Intuition you will: Lead the technical design and architecture of autonomy solutions across one or more platforms, making key trade-off decisions independently Mentor and provide technical guidance to junior and mid-level engineers, reviewing designs and code to maintain high engineering standards Develop and adapt mission behaviour, navigation, and decision-making logic to meet the needs of diverse defense platforms and missions Design and implement autonomy capabilities that are modular and reusable across different vehicle types and programs Integrate and deploy autonomy solutions onto embedded Linux and other hardware platforms, including interfacing with sensors and collecting data Conduct system-level setup, testing, and validation, including software-in-the-loop (SIL) and hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) evaluations Support live flight test of autonomy software on Group 1-5 unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) Troubleshoot complex software and integration issues to ensure high reliability and performance across the stack Collaborate with 3rd party UAS vendors and cross-functional teams to bring autonomy software to life on OEM and Applied hardware alike Who we’re looking for: BS or MS in Robotics, Computer Science, or related engineering field 6+ years of hands-on experience working with robotic systems (hardware, software, and integration) Demonstrated experience leading technical design decisions on complex, ambiguous autonomy problems with minimal guidance Experience developing autonomy behavior and decision-making logic (e.g., behavior trees, state machines) and/or navigation algorithms for robotic or autonomous systems Experience with modern C++ Experience integrating autonomy/robotics products with Pixhawk autopilots (ArduPilot and/or PX4) Experience integrating with communication busses & protocols: UART/RS232/RS422/RS485, SPI/QSPI, I2C, Ethernet Experience developing in Docker, containerized deployment environments, and using Linux-based operating systems (e.g., RHEL, Ubuntu) Familiarity with real-time, edge computing, and safety-critical systems operating in software-in-the-loop (SIL), hardware-in-the-loop (HIL), test & operational environments Excellent communication skills and a customer-oriented project delivery mindset Travel Requirements: General willingness to travel for company business between our offices, as well as to customer sites Security Requirements: Must have ability to hold UK Security Clearance (current or previous preferred) Don’t meet every single requirement? description: Hello! I’m Allie, Head of Support at Ashby. I’m excited to share that we’re hiring a Product Support Engineer in EMEA 🎉 We’re expanding our global Support team to provide 24/7 coverage across time zones. You’ll join a global team while establishing the technical Support Engineering presence in EMEA, with the ownership and visibility that come from being its first Support Engineer across European time zones. We staff across regions rather than relying on on-call rotations; we’ll discuss the specific schedule for this opening during the process. Not sure which Support role is right for you? We’re hiring for both Product Support Specialist and Product Support Engineer roles. Support Specialist owns cases and customer communication end-to-end. Troubleshoots complex issues by navigating internal tooling — audit logs, user experience testing, and API testing — to help customers reach successful outcomes. Support Engineering serves as the escalation point between Support Specialists and Product Engineering. Owns integrations, supports data mapping and data migrations for customers, and resolves escalated tickets that don't require product code changes. Please choose the role that best reflects your experience and interests rather than applying to both. If another Support role seems like a closer match, we’ll consider that in our review. About the role Support Engineering is the technical layer between frontline Support and Engineering. You’ll take on complex issues involving integrations, APIs, permissions, data, reporting, migrations, and workflows—using application behavior, logs, databases, and customer context to determine whether an issue can be resolved through Support or represents a product defect. You’ll investigate issues end to end using tools such as Plain, GitHub, Datadog, databases, and the codebase. You won’t write the fix; you’ll give Engineering a well-validated escalation with reproduction steps, relevant evidence, customer impact, and a root-cause hypothesis when possible. You’ll also identify recurring issues, improve documentation and enablement, and partner with Product and Engineering on improvements. As Ashby’s first Support Engineer in EMEA, you’ll establish regional operating practices and handoff norms across European time zones while bringing EMEA customer patterns to a global team. What you’ll own Own complex technical issues from intake through resolution or escalation—investigating APIs, integrations, logs, data, configuration, and workflows to determine whether Support can resolve them or Engineering should be involved. Set a high bar for complex technical investigations and ensure Engineering receives clear, actionable, well-validated product issues. Build trusted working relationships with frontline Support, Engineering, Product, Customer Success, and customers. Identify recurring problems and turn them into documentation, enablement, tooling, process improvements, or product feedback. Partner with Product and Engineering on recurring product improvements by synthesizing customer patterns, validating defects, and sharing the technical context needed to choose between a product change, documentation, tooling, or process improvement. Establish EMEA coverage, handoff, and operating practices across European time zones while bringing regional customer patterns to the global Support Engineering team. Track and improve the outcomes that matter: resolution speed, escalation quality, fewer avoidable Engineering escalations, frontline self-sufficiency, reduced customer effort, and customer confidence. You should apply if: You’ve worked in a hands-on, customer-centric technical role where you independently investigate ambiguous issues involving APIs, integrations, logs, data, and application behavior. You’re comfortable moving between customer conversations, APIs, logs, databases, product behavior, and code-level context to find root causes. You can distinguish a configuration, data, documentation, or enablement issue from a true product defect—and explain your reasoning clearly. You write precise investigations that others can quickly understand and act on, and communicate thoughtfully with technical and non-technical audiences across time zones. You naturally look beyond the immediate ticket and improve the systems around it through documentation, enablement, tooling, or process design. You want to be the first technical owner for EMEA and are energized by building regional structure within a global team. You should not apply if: You’re looking primarily for a high-volume support role centered on predefined troubleshooting steps, rather than open-ended technical investigation and ownership. Most of your experience is in internal IT, help desk, endpoint, hardware, network, infrastructure, cloud operations, systems administration, infrastructure maintenance, or service deployment—and you haven’t worked extensively with customer-centric SaaS applications, APIs, logs, or data-backed troubleshooting. You prefer to pass difficult issues to another team rather than reproduce, investigate, and explain them yourself. You’re looking for a role focused mainly on writing production code; this role diagnoses and escalates bugs but does not own code changes. You prefer clear-cut problems and predefined answers over working through ambiguity with careful documentation, focused questions, and evidence-based decisions. You want a narrowly defined role without regional operating ownership or projects that improve how the broader Support team works. About Ashby Ashby builds a suite of products that helps talent leaders, recruiters, and hiring managers run their hiring process significantly better. We raised a $50M Series D in July 2025 and support nearly 5,000 customers, including Shopify, Snowflake, OpenAI, Deliveroo, and Confluent. We’re growing much faster than 100% year over year, with a team of roughly 300 people across 22+ countries. Learn more at ashbyhq.com . Here are a few points that should give you an idea of what it is like to work with us: We spend a lot of time building best-in-class products since we believe a highly differentiated product is easier to sell. We also spend a lot of time building a best-in-class customer experience. We aim to offer deep expertise whenever we interact with prospects and customers. We strongly believe that small teams with very talented people and the right work environment deliver much better performance than teams with large headcount. We value a strong sense of ownership, principled thinking over experience, and thoughtful communication (we put a lot of effort into using the right communication channels) - we’ll get into these and other values during the hiring process. You can take a look at our Leadership Principles to get a sense of what we value in People Leaders at Ashby. description: About The Role and Team Quantum Motion is a fast-growing quantum computing scale-up based in London founded by internationally renowned researchers from UCL and Oxford University with over 40 years’ experience in developing qubits and quantum computing architectures. Our team of 100+ is based across London, Oxford, San Sebastián and Sydney, with our primary hub in Islington (London). We are looking for a Senior Electrical Characterisation Engineer to join our Process Integration team and play a key role in understanding, qualifying and improving the silicon devices at the heart of our quantum processors. You will sit at a fascinating intersection between semiconductor manufacturing and quantum hardware, working closely with foundries, process engineers and quantum engineers. You will use electrical characterisation and large-scale data analysis to understand manufacturing variability, identify the root causes of device behaviour, and feed those insights directly back into the semiconductor fabrication process. This is an opportunity to have a tangible impact on the yield, quality and scalability of quantum processors, working with some of the most advanced silicon technology being developed for quantum computing. Functions of the Role Drive electrical characterisation of fabricated silicon devices , developing and continuously improving high-throughput screening methods to assess key device parameters including threshold voltage, gate oxide reliability and channel mobility. Turn electrical data into manufacturing insight , identifying patterns, variability and device failures and connecting them back to semiconductor process steps such as photolithography, etching, oxide growth, CMP and doping. Develop automated measurement and test infrastructure , creating robust Python-based test routines and instrument-control workflows across room-temperature and, where appropriate, low-temperature wafer probing environments. Analyse large-scale electrical datasets using statistical process control, yield analysis and other data-driven techniques to monitor wafer uniformity, defect density and process drift. Work directly with semiconductor foundries and process engineers , providing clear, actionable feedback that can be used to improve device performance, consistency and yield. Build scalable characterisation processes , establishing testing standards, calibration procedures, SOPs and data pipelines that allow information to flow effectively between semiconductor process integration and quantum engineering teams. Help shape how we characterise the next generation of our technology , bringing your expertise and ideas to continuously improve our measurement capability as Quantum Motion scales. We are looking for someone who combines strong semiconductor device knowledge with a practical, data-driven approach to electrical characterisation. Experience - Essentials Master's or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Microelectronics, Semiconductor Physics, Materials Science or a closely related discipline. 3+ years' experience in semiconductor device testing, reliability engineering, electrical characterisation or yield analysis within a foundry, IDM or semiconductor R&D environment. Strong understanding of silicon CMOS fabrication processes, semiconductor device physics and foundry workflows. Hands-on experience with semiconductor parameter analysers, SMUs and wafer probe stations, including DC and/or RF electrical testing. Strong Python skills, particularly for instrument control, automation and automated test execution. A highly analytical approach and the ability to work with large datasets to identify trends, anomalies and root causes. Excellent communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across semiconductor, process, hardware and quantum engineering teams. Experience - Desirable It would be particularly valuable if you also have experience in: Quantum device physics, including quantum dots, single-electron transistors (SETs) or charge-stability mapping. Cryogenic electrical characterisation and low-temperature measurement systems. Semiconductor yield improvement, process control or statistical analysis. Automated wafer-level testing and high-throughput characterisation. Working with advanced or emerging semiconductor technologies. title: Head of Marketing (London or Remote)
description: About Nebuly Nebuly is a fast-growing, VC-backed startup building the platform that proves the ROI of enterprise AI. Every enterprise function — sales, customer support, HR, finance — is deploying AI agents at scale, and budgets are following fast. But most companies can't answer a basic question: is this spend actually working?Every enterprise deploying AI agents is asking the same question: is this actually delivering value? Today, almost none of them can answer it. The signal that could answer it is right there — millions of conversations happening every day between employees, customers, and these agents — but it's unstructured, high-volume, and invisible without the right infrastructure. So the ROI question stays unanswered, not because the answer doesn't exist, but because no one can see it. Nebuly makes that signal visible. It sits on top of any enterprise AI deployment, turns those conversations into a clear answer — is this working, and where — and connects the dots back to ROI. Think of it as the accountability layer for enterprise AI: connect once, see the impact, prove the value — with no data ever leaving your environment. Every new data category has created a new software category. CRM turned customer interactions into pipeline accountability. Product analytics turned user behavior into growth accountability. Nebuly is building that same layer for AI — turning millions of invisible conversations into a clear answer on value. Our customers include Oura, CNH Industrial, Vodafone, and Moncler. Demand is accelerating fast, and we're building the team to match. Your Role As our first Head of Marketing, you will own positioning and pipeline generation for the company - the two things that matter most at this stage. We have ambitious ARR growth targets and are scaling our AE team significantly; marketing needs to contribute pipeline in months, not years. You will personally own 2-3 core areas - most importantly positioning (working closely with our co-founder to translate the founding vision into something sharp, clear, and externally compelling) and lead generation feeding sales. Everything else - PR, content, events, and so on - you will delegate to the team you build. Direct partnership with co-founders on positioning, and a mandate to build the team and process from scratch. Equity. You are early. That means something.
